name: linux_triage
description: Parse a Linux disk image or extracted root with dissect.target, including E01 images whose root is inside LVM. The complete JSONL from every artefact family is kept under out_dir; the inline result only names and hashes those files, so nothing is truncated.

source.description: An E01/raw/VM disk image or extracted Linux root

out_dir.description: A new directory under work/ or the job output for the complete JSONL results

groups.description: Optional families: identity, users, sessions, authentication, history, persistence, packages, ssh, logs, web, containers
